title: [question] symmetric keys stored per client
body:
Hi, playing with a Node.js implementation. My understanding is that the connect token has two fields: `client_to_server` and `server_to_client` keys. These are symmetric keys that are shared between the client, web server, and backend servers, and they are protected by both HTTPS and encryption with the private key.

My question: that means the servers should be creating and storing these symmetric keys per client to be later reference, right?

nodes.body: Hmm, never mind, got confused. The symmetric keys are just used at face value.
